nativeComparisons.compares: CLI output bytes against .build/reference/ffmpeg run at test time (commit 946fcce0, --disable-x86asm asserted from build-metadata.json): 7932 raw-input framecrc, 1080 WAV-input WAV/raw/framecrc files with output -ss/-t/-frames:a, 1200 composed-chain framecrc; 480 native md5 runs showing asetnsamples=n=7:p=0 and =8 agree for dii/tdi/tdii/latt/svf/zdf and 2 showing di differs; 30 refusals against native exit status

unsupported: transform=di (the default; native output depends on frame boundaries) - refused for every precision
coefficient sets outside the second-order stability triangle after normalisation, and zdf sets whose raw state matrix is unstable - refused
prepared coefficients beyond the float range - refused
option expressions, SI suffixes and non-decimal values; normalize spellings other than 0/1/true/false - refused
timeline enable= and runtime commands - refused
non-finite float input or kernel output - refused at run time
automatic sample-rate conversion around biquad - refused
FLAC input - refused before decoding (flacInput not declared)
non-linux/x64 byte exactness - no native evidence (FMA contraction on macOS)

proposedContracts.name: runs against the pinned native commit built without x86 assembly
matches native framecrc for every transform and precision across raw sources, channel counts and rates
proposedContracts.scope: 7932 framecrc comparisons: raw u8/s16le/s32le/f32le/f64le, 1-3 channels, 8000/44100 Hz, 6 transforms x 5 precisions x 9 direct-form (5 zdf) coefficient sets, plus s16/s32/f64 outputs of precision auto

proposedContracts.name: writes native-identical WAV, raw and framecrc outputs from WAV inputs under output -ss, -t and -frames:a
proposedContracts.scope: 1080 WAV/raw/framecrc files from WAV inputs in five formats, mono/stereo, output -ss/-t/-ss -t/-frames:a 1 and 2

proposedContracts.name: matches native with asetnsamples=7 and =8 before biquad, volume after it and aformat before it
proposedContracts.scope: 1200 framecrc chains with asetnsamples=n=7:p=0 and =8, volume after, aformat=s32/dbl before; native md5 equal for n=7 and n=8 in 240 configurations, unequal for di

proposedContracts.name: fails explicitly before output where native fails, and for accepted forms that remain unimplemented
proposedContracts.scope: 30 refusals against native exit status (11 native errors, 18 natively accepted but refused, rate conversion); no output file

proposedContracts.name: parses named, aliased and positional options with native defaults and prepares coefficients in native order
proposedContracts.scope: option syntax, defaults, aliases, positional order; a0 division, normalize, lattice, SVF and raw zdf coefficients

proposedContracts.name: refuses native errors and unimplemented forms with exact messages
proposedContracts.scope: exact messages for di, blocksize, channels, a0=0, stability, float range, enable, ranges and unsupported values

proposedContracts.name: negotiates the automatic list and pinned precisions, refuses rate conversion and plans one frame plus the per-channel cache
proposedContracts.scope: negotiatedSampleFormats for every input and precision, requiresScalarRounding, capabilities, planSamples/packetSections/plannedReservations/reservations

proposedContracts.name: matches a transcription of the C loops for every transform and working type, identically for 1/7/29/50-sample splits, without touching its input
proposedContracts.scope: six kernels x s16p/s32p/fltp/dblp, packed/planar, 1/7/29/50-sample splits, ownership and timestamps

proposedContracts.name: runs the shared kernels in place and counts clipped samples
proposedContracts.scope: biquad-kernels.ts in-place API and clip counts

proposedContracts.name: enforces allocation, state, format and cancellation limits
proposedContracts.scope: maxFrameBytes, cache limit, stable format, non-finite input, AbortSignal

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
formats() is the native array (auto list or one pinned planar format); no negotiate, nativeFormats or flacInput declared.

All byte comparisons are gated to linux-x64 with it.skipIf in constant-title tests; the gate is a precaution from the determinism notes (macOS FMA contraction), no macOS difference was measured here. Metadata and refusal tests run everywhere.

zdf stability: besides the normalised triangle the spec requires, zdf also requires its raw-coefficient state matrix [[2a0-1,-2a1],[2a1,1-2a2]] to be stable, because zdf ignores the normalised values; typical direct-form sets (e.g. the low-pass) are therefore refused for zdf. Native accepts them and diverges.
The stability triangle is checked in double and after the float copy.
biquad-kernels.ts exports normalizeBiquad, biquadLattice, biquadStateVariable, prepareBiquad and biquadKernel for the later biquad-family filters; it has no di kernel.

Setup durations: Node 24.11.1 tarball install ~20s (sandbox Node was 22.23.5, bootstrap requires 24+); bootstrap --only npm,submodule,reference 204s (npm 10s, submodule 7.7s, reference build ~186s); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry tests 62s; biquad differential file ~100s with --maxWorkers=1; unit file ~2s.
Environment: no problems beyond the Node version; FLAC codec not built (not needed).
